name: Halewise
summary: A personal health app with a live heart trace, vitals charts, visits, records and medicines
about: A seven-page personal health app on frosted glass, with a year of sample readings. It tracks heart rate, blood pressure, glucose, weight, sleep and steps, books and reschedules doctor visits, keeps lab records with range flags and runs a daily medicine checklist with refills.
how: Open Today: the heart trace sweeps live, the BPM ticks and the move, water and sleep rings fill
Tick a dose in Medicines today; the ring, the pack count and the header update
Click a vital tile or open Vitals, pick a metric and switch 7D, 30D or 12M to morph the chart
Log a reading with checks for sensible values; out-of-range readings raise a notification
Book, reschedule or cancel visits from the list or by clicking a day on the month calendar
Open a lab record to see each result on its normal-range bar, then share or download it
Change weight units, reminders and theme or reset the demo data in Profile
